_note: Indications the pipeline can build. Add one with npm run new-indication -- "<name>": a scoping Task run proposes the entry from a ClinicalTrials.gov preview, and a person reviews it before building (see README, "Add an indication"). The first six entries were written by hand. Indications in "exclude" are never built.
